results.outcomeText: Frances Tiafoe defeated Alex Michelsen in five sets.
results.recapText: Tiafoe recovered from two sets down to win the US Open quarterfinal 5-7, 3-6, 7-5, 6-3, 7-6(6).

results.outcomeText: Aryna Sabalenka defeated Linda Noskova in three sets.
results.recapText: Sabalenka reached the US Open semifinals with a 7-6(1), 3-6, 7-6(7) quarterfinal win.

results.outcomeText: Ben Shelton defeated Carlos Alcaraz in five sets.
results.recapText: Shelton ended Alcaraz's title defence with a 6-7(5), 6-1, 6-3, 1-6, 7-6(7) quarterfinal win.

results.outcomeText: Jessica Pegula defeated Emma Navarro in three sets.
results.recapText: Pegula recovered from a set down to win the US Open quarterfinal 3-6, 6-4, 6-3.

results.outcomeText: Sydney Roosters defeated Canterbury-Bankstown Bulldogs 42-12.
results.recapText: The Roosters completed an unbeaten regular season with a 42-12 Round 11 win.

results.outcomeText: Canberra Raiders defeated Wests Tigers 22-10.
results.recapText: Canberra closed Round 11 with a 22-10 win over Wests Tigers.

results.outcomeText: Parramatta Eels defeated North Queensland Cowboys 33-28.
results.recapText: Parramatta overturned a 22-6 deficit and sealed a 33-28 Round 11 win.

results.score: Cronulla-Sutherland Sharks 16-8 St George Illawarra Dragons
results.outcomeText: Cronulla-Sutherland Sharks defeated St George Illawarra Dragons 16-8.
results.recapText: Cronulla finished the regular season with a 16-8 Round 11 win.

results.outcomeText: Brisbane Broncos defeated New Zealand Warriors 52-18.
results.recapText: Brisbane scored seven second-half tries in a 52-18 Round 11 win.

results.outcomeText: Gold Coast Titans defeated Newcastle Knights 32-20.
results.recapText: Gold Coast extended its winning run to ten matches with a 32-20 Round 11 victory.

results.outcomeText: Knights defeated Rabbitohs 20-10.
results.recapText: Newcastle eliminated South Sydney with a 20-10 Finals Week 1 win.

results.outcomeText: Dolphins defeated Warriors 26-16.
results.recapText: The Dolphins came from behind to win 26-16 and advance to a preliminary final.

results.outcomeText: Sharks defeated Cowboys 26-16.
results.recapText: Cronulla eliminated North Queensland with a 26-16 Finals Week 1 win.

results.outcomeText: Panthers defeated Roosters 19-12.
results.recapText: Penrith won the qualifying final 19-12 to reach a seventh straight preliminary final.

results.score: 1. Lando Norris · 2. Kimi Antonelli · 3. Max Verstappen
results.outcomeText: Lando Norris took pole for the Spanish Grand Prix.
results.recapText: Norris qualified first ahead of Antonelli and Verstappen in Madrid.

results.score: 1. Kimi Antonelli · 2. Max Verstappen · 3. Lando Norris
results.outcomeText: Kimi Antonelli won the Spanish Grand Prix.
results.recapText: Antonelli won in Madrid ahead of Verstappen and Norris to extend his championship lead.

results.score: 1. Marc Marquez · 2. Alex Marquez · 3. Pedro Acosta
results.outcomeText: Marc Marquez won the San Marino Grand Prix.
results.recapText: Marc Marquez won at Misano ahead of Alex Marquez and Pedro Acosta and moved into the championship lead.

results.outcomeText: Oliver Solberg and Elliott Edmondson won Rally Chile Bio Bio.
results.recapText: Solberg and Edmondson won Rally Chile in 2:57:08.2 in a Toyota GR Yaris Rally1, 16.6 seconds clear of Sebastien Ogier and Vincent Landais.

results.outcomeText: Australia and China advanced to the quarterfinals.
results.recapText: Australia edged Italy 82-80 and China defeated Puerto Rico 75-72 in qualification games.

results.outcomeText: Germany and Hungary advanced to the quarterfinals.
results.recapText: Germany defeated Korea 94-56 and Hungary beat Japan 84-63 in qualification games.

results.score: Spain 89-66 Australia · Germany 93-74 Belgium · France 90-61 China · USA 108-56 Hungary
results.outcomeText: Spain, Germany, France and USA reached the semifinals.
results.recapText: Spain, Germany, France and USA won the four World Cup quarterfinals in Berlin.

results.outcomeText: USA and France reached the World Cup final.
results.recapText: USA defeated Spain 76-66 and France beat Germany 86-64 in the semifinals.

results.outcomeText: Spain defeated Germany 81-58 to win bronze.
results.recapText: Spain secured the World Cup bronze medal with an 81-58 win over hosts Germany.

results.outcomeText: USA defeated France 97-79 to win the World Cup.
results.recapText: USA won a fifth consecutive and 12th overall Women's World Cup title with a 97-79 final victory.
